# Badge > Compact status, label, or count chip. This file matches the installed `badge` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/badge.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/badge.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/badge-knobs`: `badgeKnobs`, types `BadgeKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/badge`: `badgeVariants`, `badgeSizes`, `BADGE_COLORS`, `Badge`, types `BadgeVariant`, `BadgeSize`, `BadgeColor`, `BadgeProps` ## Composition ### Status or label ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { Check } from "lucide-react"; import type { BadgeColor } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/badge"; import { Badge } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/badge"; const badgeColors: BadgeColor[] = ["neutral", "red", "orange", "yellow", "green", "blue", "purple", "pink"]; export function PrimitiveBadgeExample() { return (
Default Small Beta 15 Denied 3 Primary Outline Allowed {badgeColors.map((color) => ( {color} ))} }>Link badge
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `badge` - `root`: `data-color` (any value), `data-size` (`md` | `sm`), `data-variant` (`default` | `outline`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### badge - `--cui-badge-icon`: `1em` - `--cui-badge-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-badge-background`: `var(--_badge-color-background)` - `--cui-badge-foreground`: `var(--_badge-color-foreground)` - `--cui-badge-border-color`: `transparent` - `--cui-badge-border-width`: `1px` - `--cui-badge-font-family`: `var(--font-body)` - `--cui-badge-font-size`: `var(--text-caption)` - `--cui-badge-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/badge - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/badge.json
